rootCause: Codespaces discovery excluded ShuttingDown; a saved environment transitioning to Shutdown after the initial lookup was only polled and never resumed.
change: Reuse a matching ShuttingDown environment, wait for Shutdown, then request resume at most once within the existing deadline. Transient response reconciliation and immediate authorization/quota failures remain covered.

outcomes: Discovery attempted an unexpected create instead of retaining the environment.
Saved environment timed out without resuming after shutdown.
Stuck shutdown attempted an unexpected create instead of reaching its deadline.

scope: Deterministic provider-state regressions. The initial Svelte discovery response was not captured, so this does not establish why that live launch created new compute.

controlledNativeComputeStop.scope: Controlled stop of the Svelte QA Codespace after both application launches stopped; state observed before launch harness, not an assertion of the state seen by the adapter.

liveVerification.scope: Controlled provider stop was observed ShuttingDown before launching; subsequently Starting and the same environment became ready. Exact initial adapter response was not captured. No native browser or backend database claim.
